title: GTA 6 credits fired Rockstar employees: 28 of 34 named
description: GTA 6 credits fired Rockstar employees: Eurogamer found at least 28 of 34 dismissed staff named as a Scotland tribunal over union busting ends.

body.text: The GTA 6 credits fired Rockstar employees story has a new twist. According to Eurogamer, at least 28 of the 34 people Rockstar dismissed about a year ago are named in the credits of Grand Theft Auto 6. The firings led directly to an employment tribunal in Scotland, and the proceedings end on the eve of the game's launch, which makes the timing hard to ignore.
What Eurogamer found in the GTA 6 credits

Eurogamer checked a list of 34 names, supplied by the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB), against the game's credits. The IWGB is the organisation taking action against Rockstar for the fired workers.

The cross-check turned up 28 direct matches. There were also a couple of discrepancies, which Eurogamer says it has since verified, plus a few close-sounding names it is still trying to clarify. The outlet adds that some names may simply be missing from the credits.
Eurogamer will not publish the list, citing privacy reasons. So the figure of at least 28 rests on the outlet's own checking and cannot be independently verified by readers.

Some of the fired employees are seeking compensation for unfair dismissal. The case also involves allegations of "union busting". These are claims being tested at the tribunal, not established findings.
According to Eurogamer, the tribunal wraps up today, one day before GTA 6 goes on sale. The outlet says the outcome will be historic either way.
A huge game, and a huge team
Rockstar recently said more than 4,711 people worked on GTA 6 across 12 offices worldwide. Eurogamer notes that headcount is more than double what it was for Red Dead Redemption 2.
The game has already impressed critics, and Eurogamer gave it five stars in its review. Observers quoted in the piece expect it to bring in $2bn in its opening weekend alone.

Eurogamer's Christian Donlan also weighed in after watching the Netflix "extended look" trailer. His argument was that a studio spending so heavily on detail, and telling an underdog story, should let the people who built the game form a union.

faqs.q: How many fired Rockstar employees are in the GTA 6 credits?
faqs.a: Eurogamer confirmed that at least 28 of the 34 fired employees appear in the credits. It also found a couple of verified discrepancies and some close-sounding names it is still trying to clarify.

faqs.q: Why were the 34 Rockstar employees fired?
faqs.a: The source does not give Rockstar's reasons. It says the dismissals led to an employment tribunal in Scotland, where some of the fired staff are seeking compensation for unfair dismissal amid allegations of union busting.

faqs.q: Who is taking action against Rockstar over the firings?
faqs.a: The Independent Workers Union of Great Britain is taking action on behalf of the fired employees. The union also supplied Eurogamer with the list of 34 names.

sources.title: Most, though not quite all, of the 34 fired Rockstar employees are named in the GTA 6 credits
